title: The Multipack and the Stronger Surge Line
lessons: The player first buys White Claw through a multipack that includes several familiar flavors rather than choosing one single flavor.
The player already drinks standard White Claw and notices that Surge is a stronger 8% ABV line.

text: First time buying it. You're not picking a flavor. You're picking the twelve-pack with four of them in it, because that's what everyone else at the party did.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: This is the everybody-can-live-with-it pack, right?

entry-first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: That's a brutal way to describe a genuinely successful party format, but sure, yes.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Nobody has to pick one flavor and defend it.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Black Cherry, Pineapple, Cranberry, Lime. One box, four answers, no group chat about whose turn it is to pick.

choice-first.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Cart or shelf? Line's short right now.

choices.text: I'm going to end up with one flavor nobody wants.
I don't want twelve cans just to find out if I like this.

first-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. That's the whole reason it exists. Nobody wants to bet twelve cans on one flavor they've never had.

first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Every variety pack has a flavor that becomes fridge furniture for somebody. That's the deal, honestly.

first-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then a single can at a bar is a better first date. Fair. I don't need to sell you a case tonight.
Same aisle, same cans, and a new one next to them that says Surge. Eight percent.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Eight percent. Stronger than the regular one. I'm not doing a bit about this. That number should be the first thing you notice, before the flavor.

choice-return.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: So. Regular or Surge? It matters more than usual.

choices.text: I'm glad the difference is right there on the can.
I'd have to change how I pace myself with this one.
I don't want a stronger version sitting next to the one I actually drink.

return-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. It's on the can in big type because the can looks like every other can. I wanted the number to be louder than the flavor.

return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Check the number first. Then decide whether tonight's the night for it.

return-2-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: It's the important one. I'm not going to make this funnier than it needs to be.

return-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then the regular one, or Zero Proof, the one with no alcohol. Both are right there. Neither needs an explanation at checkout.
